summary: The change passes. It splits crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs into four new files under briefs/ (boundary.rs, reader.rs, planner.rs, plan.rs). `athena status` on the snapshot now reports briefs.rs at 1411 production lines with a longest function of 100 lines, and no new file is over a limit. reader_brief is now a short list of calls to one helper per section. I compared it with the base function from git history: the sections come in the same order with the same strings, so the brief text should be unchanged. I checked the code moves by diffing each new file against the base briefs.rs. Apart from module docs, imports, pub(super) markers and the reader_brief helper headers, every line comes from the base. briefs.rs only re-exports the moved items and adjusts imports. No tabs were introduced. The test module changed only its imports, and no test reads briefs.rs as text. On the snapshot I ran the athena-context tests (127 passed) and the xtask policy test (17 passed). For the full test suite, clippy and fmt I relied on the passing CI results Athena recorded (run 42544880094). The CHANGELOG entry is accurate. The only finding is a nit: xtask/tests/policy.rs and lib.rs were listed as files to modify but needed no change.
